brief: Original voice for a thumb-sized, round, fluffy felt creature with a big head and tall cloud of hair: adorable, sunny and bubbly. Gender-neutral, young-sounding but not a baby. High and bright with soft fuzzy edges, like a warm adult voice raised six to eight semitones with small-creature formants. Bouncy sing-song delivery, delighted little gasps, giggles easily. No accent, no resemblance to any actor or existing character. Dry studio recording, no reverb.
